source_scope: Local changed source compiled before its development commit; exact tested files are bound below.
changes: Explicit native format-7 exact cross-file/same-file extent coalescing with independent CPU equality and smallest-existing-encoding selection; legacy 1..6 alias rejection retained.
Private detachment before changed shared writes/truncate-tail updates; exact reversion before object allocation; reference-safe delete/retire and immutable old snapshots.
Mandatory MSVC /EHsc for C++ targets plus store compile-time unwinding guard; bounded underlying compaction-error context.
Local process-tree build/test supervisor and private offline source-bound semantic audit; blanket hosted-only/VM-first policy removed.
interpretation: Two identical 64-KiB files: complete freshly compacted image saves 65536 bytes versus an equivalent unshared control. Both images exceed 131072 source bytes. This is an exact-duplicate primitive result, not extreme compression, generic filesystem throughput or GPU benefit.
tested_behaviors: Cross-file and same-file sharing, unique/empty/no-op controls, and choosing a later smaller encoding for equal decoded bytes.
Partial writes, multi-mutation original reattachment before allocation, shrink/regrow, deleting first/last references and detached-inode writes/retirement.
Old snapshots, independently current unshared comparator, compact/resume and public CPU readback.
Legacy/unknown format rejection, invalid dependencies and noncanonical EOF bytes.
Every modeled write/flush fault boundary before sharing and after shared private mutation; terminal fencing and independently opened recovery.
